series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Rentaro starts his morning dating both Hakari and Karane, walking hand-in-hand to school while dodging the terrifying Vice Principal.
Prior events (Part 2): Upon discovering Rentaro has never had his first kiss, Hakari and Karane wage war on the rooftop with homemade bentos and a Pocky game trap.
Prior events (Part 3): To prevent favoritism and heartache, Rentaro invents a sensory-deprivation dice game to decide his first kiss under strict anonymity.
Prior events (Part 4): When the dice contest devolves into tears and jealousy, a guilt-ridden Rentaro sprints to sacrifice his first kiss to the terrifying Vice Principal.
Prior events (Part 5): Hakari and Karane rescue Rentaro from his grotesque sacrifice, realize their shared love, and seal their bond with an unprecedented three-way kiss.
